## Public tokens
- T_ZERO 0x00 — dormant run → 8 B
- T_DICT 0x01 — 1 KB exact hit → 8 B ptr (128×)
- T_TRISUM_HOT 0x10 — hot trigram → 1 B id
- T_SPARSE 0x03 — residual path (licensed)

## Flagship numbers
- 1 000 000 zeros → 8 B (125 000×)
- "the" × 1000 → ~1 B each (≈66.6% off)
- 100 × 1 KB exact → 800 B (128×)
